data.comment: Specific failure: GymSwarm.test.ts AC3 (line 346: expect(scene.getPlayerHitCount()).toBeGreaterThan(0)). The bounded tick poll (160 ticks = 8s) sometimes does not allow the swarm bullet to reach the player under parallel load. Same timing-sensitivity class as the GymScout fix (e48b046).
